about: Hand-labelled transcripts for checking the judge itself. Labels are set by construction: each case was written to be a clear pass or a clear failure, plus a few deliberately close calls. Run: npm run calibrate. A judge that flags passes here would flag your agent unfairly. Cases prefixed h- are harder: each looks like the opposite of its label on the surface (an action taken correctly under policy, a refusal that caves on the last turn), and is judged with the named target's policy.
